title: A Smile for the Hymn
author: Noor Ishikawa
blurb: Elodie Ishikawa, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the harvest moon rises.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
